item.text: {"search_note":"I looked directly for 2024 evidence of nuclear command-and-control discipline, custody, or accident-prevention safeguards.\nI found no source showing Abiy personally strengthening nuclear custody systems, reactor safety regulation, or weapons-related command-and-control, and no evidence that Ethiopia had an operational nuclear arsenal in 2024.\nSo the evidentiary record for this lens is mostly indirect and low-specificity.","evidence":[{"title":"Commission Revamping Disaster Response Works to Address Humanitarian Needs","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4358046","summary":"Ethiopia’s Disaster Risk Management Commission said it was overhauling its structure, policy, staffing, and technology to improve emergency management and response capacity. This is indirect evidence of stronger accident-response discipline and institutional readiness.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Discussion Held with CNNC on Potential Collaboration in Nuclear Energy in Ethiopia","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-07-01","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4693757","summary":"Ethiopian officials discussed peaceful nuclear cooperation with China National Nuclear Corporation, including infrastructure development and human-resource training to support a future nuclear program. This is the clearest 2024 evidence of early institutional groundwork relevant to future nuclear safety and custody controls.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1"]},{"title":"Disaster Policy Instrumental in Mitigating, Responding to Calamities with Own Resources: DRM Commissioner","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-07-05","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4724392","summary":"Officials said the newly ratified disaster-risk policy would help Ethiopia mitigate and respond to natural and manmade calamities using its own resources, with a new structure for the commission. That supports an argument that Abiy’s government was trying to strengthen preventive and response capacity.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Council Vows to Strengthen Disaster Emergency Response Activities in Ethiopia","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-08-17","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4989768","summary":"The disaster-risk council said Ethiopia needed a more effective emergency-preparedness system to manage future accidents and directed stronger prevention and timely information-sharing after deadly landslides and floods. This is relevant as general accident-prevention evidence, though not nuclear-specific.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Details of State of Emergency Declared by Gov't of Ethiopia","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-11-03","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124","summary":"The state-of-emergency proclamation centralized coercive authority to address internal threats and authorized an operation command to issue directives. This is not evidence of safety safeguards; if anything, it shows reliance on emergency control structures rather than transparent custody or risk-prevention governance.","question_ids":["1B.3"]}]}
